scope: Host-only provided-weight diagnostic; no Device, kernel compilation, host dispatch changes or Arena submission
input: load::model_dir()/model.safetensors, read-only mmap using existing dependencies
sampling: Exactly r1194: layers 0/6/47, UP/GATE/DOWN, four boundary rows plus 60 deterministic mix-selected rows per projection, repetitions retained
reference: BF16(provided E2M1 low/high nibble * provided E4M3 per16 scale), before global scale; 4423680 values
coarse_control: Original r1194 power2 scale starts 2^-114 and doubles until 7*s>=max(2^-112,FTZ-amax); code ties away
new_rational: Exact sign(x)*floor(7*abs(FTZ(x))/A+1/2), A=max(2^-112,amax), code [-7,7], reconstruction scale RN32(A*RN32(1/7))
independent_oracle: i64 quotient (2*n+d)/(2*d) from finite BF16 mantissa/exponent; no floating DivF and no device seven-threshold implementation
grouping: independent 960-value blocks within each sampled row
provenance: Tensor names/dtypes/shapes/lengths, exact row lists and labeled noncryptographic FNV1a64 fingerprints of sampled source and decoded BF16 bytes; not a whole-model SHA
report: Code bounds/histograms, finite min/max, signed-zero/subnormal counts, scale/amax ranges, squared error/norm, relative L2 and max absolute error; timing includes decode and all four audits
failure_policy: Missing file/tensor, wrong header, nonfinite source/reconstruction or contract assertion is a hard failure, not a skipped PASS
build: Original Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock; plain cargo build --release --locked, incremental disabled, package debug0, exclusive tail256-model target and captured output
not_claimed: r742 synthetic 0.1319 is not provided-model quality
Old r742/r751 DivF failures remain failures
next_gate: Independent source review and root-dispatched bounded CPU diagnostic on supplied weights; actual output decides whether this precision route merits further complete-chain work
